title: Super Jumper Recalls Trampolines Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The welds on the metal railings (legs) can fail, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 23,000 (In addition, 860 in Canada).

title: SSR Motorsports Recalls Off-Highway Competition Motorcycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle's front fork assembly can fail during use, causing the rider to lose control, and result in a crash hazard. Units: About 420.

title: SunSetter Recalls Vinyl Covers for Motorized Awnings Due to Impact and Fall Hazards; One Death Reported (Recall Alert)
summary: If a powered awning is activated while the cover is secured with bungee tie-downs, when the cover is removed, the awning can open unexpectedly with enough force to strike a consumer standing in the awning's path, causing them to fall and suffer death or serious injury. title: Seattle Manufacturing Corporation Recalls Ice Axes Due to Serious Injury and Fall Hazards
summary: The spike and/or head of the ice axe can detach from the handle during use, posing serious injury and fall hazards to the climber. Units: About 165.

title: BRP Expands Recall of Snowmobiles Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle's fuel delivery system can leak fuel, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 14,600 (About 10,000 were previously recalled in May 2019).

title: GreatCall Recalls Lively Mobile Plus Emergency Alert Device Due to Risk of Call Button Failing in an Emergency (Recall Alert)
summary: The call button can fail when pushed by the consumer in an emergency. Units: About 44,300.

title: RH Recalls Children's Chairs and Stools Due to Violation of Federal Lead Paint Ban
summary: Paint on the chairs and stools contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 3,200 (In addition, about 180 were sold in Canada).

title: RH Recalls Turkish Robes Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The Turkish robes fail to meet the flammability standards for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 5,400 (in addition, about 300 were sold in Canada).

title: Decathlon USA Recalls Carabiners Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death
summary: Incorrect assembly can cause the carabiner to unlock while in use, posing a risk of serious injury or death to the user. Units: About 50.

title: Pearhead Recalls Ubbi Connecting Bath Toys Due To Choking Hazard
summary: The recalled toys can break and create a sharp point, posing laceration and choking hazards to young children. Units: About 6,200.

title: Rite Aid Recalls Folding Patio Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair frame can bend causing the user to fall, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 18,800.

title: Sandoz Recalls Losartan Potassium and Ezetimibe Prescription Drug Bottles Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirements
summary: The prescription drug packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act, posing a poisoning risk if swallowed by children. Units: About 636,000.

title: Kirkland's Recalls Chests of Drawers Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled chests are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. The dressers do not comply with the performance requirements of the U.S. voluntary industry standard (ASTM 2057-17). Units: About 3,

title: Whirlpool Recalls Glass Cooktops with Touch Controls Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The recalled cooktop surface elements can turn on by themselves, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 26,300 (In addition about 2,800 units were sold in Canada and 128 units in Mexico).

title: Yamaha Recalls Golf Cars, Personal Transportation and Specialty Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The module that regulates power to the vehicle's USB ports can overheat and melt, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 16,000 (The model year 2017 and 2018 units included in this alert have been previously recalled.).

title: At Home Recalls Shag Rugs Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled large shag rugs fail to meet the federal flammability standard for carpets and rugs, posing a fire hazard. The small shag rugs fail to meet federal labeling requirements. Small rugs are not required to meet the federal flammability standard; however, they are required to be permanently

title: Contigo Recalls 5.7 Million Kids Water Bottles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The water bottle's clear silicone spout can detach, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 5.7 million (In addition, about 157,000 were sold in Canada and about 28,000 sold in Mexico).

title: Happy Plugs Recalls Wireless Headphones Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The micro-USB charging cable packaged with Happy Plugs wireless headphones can cause the headphones to overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,900 (In addition, about 2,550 were sold in Canada).

title: BRP Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle can have a fuel leak at the fuel injector, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,900.

title: Norwex Recalls Rubber Brooms Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The broom handles can break in half, exposing a metal inner rim, posing a laceration hazard to the user. Units: About 58,000.

title: Piping Rock Health Products Recalls Wintergreen Essential Oil Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirements; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The bottles are not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act, posing a poisoning risk if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 18,600.

title: Crate and Barrel Recalls Push Walkers Due to Choking and Laceration Hazards
summary: Walkers can be damaged over time exposing sharp points and small parts, posing choking and laceration hazards to small children. Units: About 1,500.

title: SAMpark Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standard for children's sleepwear that requires sleepwear to be either snug-fitting or flame resistant, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 185.

title: Southwire Recalls Electrical Outlet Boxes Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The electrical receptacles can overheat when in use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,000.

title: Club Car Recalls Gas Golf and Transport Vehicles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: Fuel can leak from an improperly-routed fuel line, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 9,000 (In addition, about 2,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Club Car Recalls Gas Utility and Transport Vehicles Due to Risk of Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Under continuous operations with low speed idling periods and a full gas tank, the fuel vent can allow fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,300 (In addition, about 13 were sold in Canada).
